subject: Superintendent Succession Planning and Evaluation Process
overview: The committee established a timeline for the Superintendent's evaluation and the creation of a formal succession plan following extensive public testimony. Members also reviewed vocational school achievements, fine arts programming, and updated facility rental guidelines.

items.title: Middle School String Ensemble Performance
items.summary: The Medford Middle School String Ensemble performed for the committee, followed by the presentation of awards to individual students for musical excellence.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the minutes of May 2, 2016, along with various bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Medford Educational Foundation Presentation
items.summary: The Medford Educational Foundation presented an update on its grant program, which recently awarded nearly $7,500 to fund 11 teacher-led innovation projects across the district.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation and Succession Planning
items.summary: Following public comment regarding contract transparency, the committee voted to require the Superintendent's self-evaluation by May 20 and to initiate a formal succession planning process by June 30.

items.title: Buildings and Grounds Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Approved amended RFP guidelines for a winter bubble structure at Edgeley Field and referred the proposed facility fee schedule to a subcommittee for a public hearing.

items.title: Medford Vocational Technical High School Update
items.summary: Authorized a student trip to the SkillsUSA national competition and reviewed new grants received for teen dating violence prevention and adult construction training.

items.title: Guidance Department Pre-Budget Report
items.summary: The committee reviewed the Guidance Department's progress in social-emotional learning and college readiness, including the expansion of the C3 Day program.

items.title: Fine Arts Department Report
items.summary: Accepted the department report and approved a motion for the Superintendent to provide an inventory and valuation of musical instruments currently held in storage.

items.title: National Science Foundation Grant and Summer Programs
items.summary: Received updates on the $1.2 million Middle School Pathways grant for computer science and the schedule for upcoming summer academic and enrichment programs.

items.title: Community Schools Financial Report
items.summary: Reviewed financial data for the community pool and school rentals, and voted to require all facility users to submit applications to better track building usage.
